```{ojs}
D = FileAttachment("tracking/coverage.json").json()
// World Bank official boundaries, written by R/tracking_boundaries.R
wbCountries = FileAttachment("tracking/countries.geojson").json()
wbDisputed = FileAttachment("tracking/disputed.geojson").json()
wbBorders = FileAttachment("tracking/borders.geojson").json()
d3 = require("d3@7")

// display names; must match WB_ADM0_NA in tracking/countries.geojson
NAMES = ({ CHL: "Chile", CMR: "Cameroon", COL: "Colombia", CRI: "Costa Rica", ETH: "Ethiopia",
  JOR: "Jordan", LBN: "Lebanon", NER: "Niger", PER: "Peru", PSE: "West Bank and Gaza",
  TCD: "Chad", UGA: "Uganda" })
REGION = ({ CHL: "Latin America and Caribbean", COL: "Latin America and Caribbean",
  CRI: "Latin America and Caribbean", PER: "Latin America and Caribbean",
  CMR: "Western and Central Africa", NER: "Western and Central Africa", TCD: "Western and Central Africa",
  ETH: "Eastern and Southern Africa", UGA: "Eastern and Southern Africa",
  JOR: "Middle East and North Africa", LBN: "Middle East and North Africa", PSE: "Middle East and North Africa" })
WTYPE = ({ 1: "Consumption", 2: "Income", 3: "Expenditure" })
CORE = ["code", "year", "survname", "hhid", "pid", "welfare", "welfare_self", "welfare_type", "weight"]
CAMPURB = ["camp", "urban"]
OPT = ["natpovline", "hhsize", "age", "male", "educat4", "empstat", "arrival_year",
  "camp_pcode", "camp_name", "camp_lat", "camp_lon", "strata", "psu"]
BINS = [["b5", "100%"], ["b4", "95-99.9%"], ["b3", "75-95%"], ["b2", "50-75%"], ["b1", "1-50%"], ["b0", "0% (all missing)"]]

esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;" }[c]))
fmt = d3.format(",")
harm = D.surveys
raw = D.raw_only
all = [...harm.map(s => ({ ...s, stage: "approved" })), ...raw.map(r => ({ ...r, stage: "raw" }))]
  .sort((a, b) => NAMES[a.code].localeCompare(NAMES[b.code]) || a.year - b.year)
countries = [...new Set(all.map(s => s.code))]
years = d3.extent(all, s => s.year)
nHarm = c => harm.filter(s => s.code === c).length
label = s => `${esc(NAMES[s.code])} ${s.year} ${esc(s.survey)}`
cov = (s, v) => s.missing[v] == null ? null : Math.round((100 - s.missing[v]) * 10) / 10
bin = c => c == null ? "na" : c >= 100 ? "b5" : c >= 95 ? "b4" : c >= 75 ? "b3" : c >= 50 ? "b2" : c > 0 ? "b1" : "b0"
cellHTML = (s, v) => {
  const c = cov(s, v);
  const tip = `<b>${label(s)}</b><code>${esc(v)}</code>: ` + (c == null ? "not in file" : `${c}% non-missing`);
  return `<div class="trk-cell ${bin(c)}" data-tip="${esc(tip)}">${c != null && c < 100 ? Math.floor(c) : ""}</div>`;
}
asEl = (cls, htmlStr) => { const el = document.createElement("div"); el.className = cls; el.innerHTML = htmlStr; return el; }
```

```{ojs}
// snapshot date and headline numbers; also installs the hover tooltip
{
  const tipEl = document.getElementById("trk-tip");
  if (!window.__trkTip) {
    window.__trkTip = true;
    document.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
      const t = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("[data-tip]");
      if (!t) { tipEl.hidden = true; return; }
      tipEl.innerHTML = t.getAttribute("data-tip");
      tipEl.hidden = false;
      const r = tipEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      let x = e.clientX + 14, y = e.clientY + 14;
      if (x + r.width > innerWidth - 8) x = e.clientX - r.width - 14;
      if (y + r.height > innerHeight - 8) y = e.clientY - r.height - 14;
      tipEl.style.left = x + "px"; tipEl.style.top = y + "px";
    });
  }
  const updated = new Date(D.generated).toLocaleDateString("en-GB",
    { day: "numeric", month: "long", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
  const kpis = [
    [new Set(harm.map(s => s.code)).size, "countries with harmonized data"],
    [harm.length, "harmonized surveys"],
    [raw.length, "raw surveys awaiting harmonization"],
    [`${years[0]}-${String(years[1]).slice(2)}`, "survey years"]
  ];
  return asEl("trk", `<span class="trk-date">Last updated ${updated}</span>` +
    `<div class="trk-kpis">${kpis.map(([v, l]) =>
      `<div class="trk-kpi"><div class="v">${v}</div><div class="l">${l}</div></div>`).join("")}</div>`);
}
```

## Countries

```{ojs}
{
  const LABEL_POS = { LBN: [-8, -6, "end"], PSE: [-8, 8, "end"], JOR: [9, 8, "start"], NER: [-9, 4, "end"],
    CMR: [-9, 6, "end"], UGA: [-9, 6, "end"], CRI: [-9, 2, "end"] };
  // d3 wants clockwise outer rings; GeoJSON (RFC 7946) has them counter-clockwise.
  // A polygon covering more than half the globe has the wrong winding: reverse it.
  const rewind = f => {
    // rounding can leave a stray point or line inside a collection; d3 would draw a point as a circle
    if (f.geometry.type === "GeometryCollection")
      f.geometry.geometries = f.geometry.geometries.filter(g => /Polygon$/.test(g.type));
    if (d3.geoArea(f) > 2 * Math.PI) {
      const g = f.geometry;
      const rev = poly => poly.map(ring => ring.slice().reverse());
      if (g.type === "Polygon") g.coordinates = rev(g.coordinates);
      else if (g.type === "MultiPolygon") g.coordinates = g.coordinates.map(rev);
      else if (g.type === "GeometryCollection") g.geometries.forEach(p => rewind({ type: "Feature", geometry: p }));
    }
    return f;
  };
  const feats = wbCountries.features.map(rewind);
  const disputed = wbDisputed.features.map(rewind);
  const byName = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(NAMES).map(([k, v]) => [v, k]));
  const code = f => byName[f.properties.name];
  const covered = feats.filter(code);
  const W = 800, H = 480;
  const proj = d3.geoEqualEarth().fitExtent([[20, 16], [W - 20, H - 16]], { type: "FeatureCollection", features: covered });
  const path = d3.geoPath(proj);
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`).attr("role", "img")
    .attr("aria-label", "Map of countries with 50by35 data");
  const shade = c => nHarm(c) >= 2 ? "c2" : nHarm(c) === 1 ? "c1" : "craw";
  const tip = c => `<b>${esc(NAMES[c])}</b>` + all.filter(s => s.code === c).map(s =>
    `${s.year} ${esc(s.survey)}: ${s.stage === "raw" ? "raw only" : fmt(s.n_ind) + " people"}`).join("<br>");
  svg.append("g").selectAll("path").data([...feats, ...disputed]).join("path")
    .attr("d", path).attr("class", f => code(f) ? "land " + shade(code(f)) : "land")
    .attr("data-tip", f => code(f) ? tip(code(f)) : null);
  // boundary lines; disputed and undetermined boundaries are dashed or dotted
  const DASH = { "Dashed": "3 2", "Tightly Dashed": "1.5 1", "Dotted": "0.3 1.6" };
  svg.append("g").selectAll("path").data(wbBorders.features).join("path")
    .attr("d", path).attr("class", "border")
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", f => DASH[f.properties.style] || null);
  covered.forEach(f => {
    const c = code(f), [px, py] = proj(d3.geoCentroid(f));
    const g = svg.append("g").attr("data-tip", tip(c));
    g.append("circle").attr("cx", px).attr("cy", py).attr("r", 12).attr("fill", "transparent");
    g.append("circle").attr("cx", px).attr("cy", py).attr("r", 5).attr("class", "mk " + shade(c));
    const [dx, dy, anchor] = LABEL_POS[c] || [9, 4, "start"];
    g.append("text").attr("class", "lbl").attr("x", px + dx).attr("y", py + dy).attr("text-anchor", anchor).text(c);
  });
  const el = asEl("trk trk-card", "");
  el.append(svg.node());
  el.append(asEl("trk-legend",
    `<span><i style="background:var(--map1)"></i>1 harmonized survey</span>` +
    `<span><i style="background:var(--map2)"></i>2 harmonized surveys</span>` +
    `<span><i style="background:var(--mapraw)"></i>Raw data only</span>`));
  el.append(asEl("trk-note", "Boundaries: World Bank Official Boundaries. The boundaries, colors, denominations " +
    "and any other information shown on this map do not imply any judgment on the part of the World Bank " +
    "concerning the legal status of any territory or the endorsement or acceptance of such boundaries."));
  return el;
}
```

## Over time

```{ojs}
{
  const order = [...countries].sort((a, b) => REGION[a].localeCompare(REGION[b]) || NAMES[a].localeCompare(NAMES[b]));
  const W = 800, rowH = 30, M = { t: 24, r: 16, b: 8, l: 150 };
  const H = M.t + order.length * rowH + M.b;
  const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([years[0] - .5, years[1] + .5]).range([M.l, W - M.r]);
  const y = c => M.t + order.indexOf(c) * rowH + rowH / 2;
  const svg = d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`).attr("role", "img")
    .attr("aria-label", "Survey years by country");
  d3.range(years[0], years[1] + 1).forEach(yr => {
    svg.append("line").attr("class", "gridline").attr("x1", x(yr)).attr("x2", x(yr)).attr("y1", M.t - 6).attr("y2", H - M.b);
    svg.append("text").attr("x", x(yr)).attr("y", 12).attr("text-anchor", "middle").attr("class", "muted").text(yr);
  });
  let prevR = null;
  order.forEach(c => {
    if (REGION[c] !== prevR && prevR)
      svg.append("line").attr("class", "axisline").attr("x1", 0).attr("x2", W - M.r)
        .attr("y1", y(c) - rowH / 2).attr("y2", y(c) - rowH / 2);
    prevR = REGION[c];
    svg.append("text").attr("x", 0).attr("y", y(c) + 4).text(NAMES[c]);
  });
  all.forEach(s => {
    const g = svg.append("g").attr("data-tip", s.stage === "raw"
      ? `<b>${label(s)}</b>Raw data uploaded. Harmonization pending.`
      : `<b>${label(s)}</b>${fmt(s.n_ind)} people, ${fmt(s.n_hh)} households<br><span class="k">${WTYPE[s.welfare_type]} aggregate, ${s.vermast}/${s.veralt}</span>`);
    g.append("circle").attr("cx", x(s.year)).attr("cy", y(s.code)).attr("r", 14).attr("fill", "transparent");
    if (s.stage === "raw")
      g.append("circle").attr("cx", x(s.year)).attr("cy", y(s.code)).attr("r", 6)
        .attr("fill", "var(--surface)").attr("stroke", "var(--s2)").attr("stroke-width", 2.5);
    else
      g.append("circle").attr("cx", x(s.year)).attr("cy", y(s.code)).attr("r", 7).attr("fill", "var(--s1)").attr("class", "mk");
    g.append("text").attr("x", x(s.year) + 12).attr("y", y(s.code) + 4).attr("class", "muted").text(s.survey);
  });
  const el = asEl("trk trk-card", "");
  el.append(svg.node());
  el.append(asEl("trk-legend",
    `<span><i style="background:var(--s1);border-radius:50%"></i>Harmonized</span>` +
    `<span><i style="border:2px solid var(--s2);border-radius:50%"></i>Raw data only</span>`));
  return el;
}
```

## Variables

```{ojs}
asEl("trk trk-card", `<p class="trk-sub">Harmonized surveys with at least one non-missing value, of ${harm.length}</p>` +
  `<div class="trk-vbars">` + [...CAMPURB, ...OPT].map(v => {
    const usable = harm.filter(s => cov(s, v) > 0);
    const empty = harm.filter(s => cov(s, v) === 0);
    const tip = `<b><code>${v}</code></b>${usable.length} of ${harm.length} surveys have values` +
      (empty.length ? `<br><span class="k">In file but all missing: ${empty.map(s => s.code + " " + s.year).join(", ")}</span>` : "");
    return `<code>${v}</code>` +
      `<div class="track" data-tip="${esc(tip)}"><div class="fill" style="width:${100 * usable.length / harm.length}%"></div></div>` +
      `<span class="n">${usable.length}</span>`;
  }).join("") + `</div>`)
```

Share of rows with a non-missing value, by survey. Numbers are shown where the share is below 100%.

```{ojs}
{
  const groups = [{ label: "Mandatory", vars: ["core", ...CAMPURB] }, { label: "Optional", vars: OPT }];
  const vars = groups.flatMap(g => g.vars);
  // the core variables may not be missing, so they share one column
  const coreCell = s => {
    const ok = CORE.every(v => cov(s, v) === 100);
    const tip = `<b>${label(s)}</b>Core variables (${CORE.join(", ")}): ${ok ? "complete" : "some missing"}`;
    return `<div class="trk-cell ${ok ? "b5" : "b3"}" data-tip="${esc(tip)}">${ok ? "" : "!"}</div>`;
  };
  let h = `<div></div>` + groups.map(g => `<div class="grp" style="grid-column: span ${g.vars.length}">${g.label}</div>`).join("");
  h += `<div></div>` + vars.map(v => `<div class="hdr">${v === "core" ? "core (9)" : v}</div>`).join("");
  let prev = null;
  all.filter(s => s.stage === "approved").forEach(s => {
    if (prev && prev !== s.code) h += `<div class="sep"></div>`;
    h += `<div class="rl"><span>${prev === s.code ? "" : esc(NAMES[s.code])}</span><span class="yr">${s.year} ${esc(s.survey)}</span></div>` +
      vars.map(v => v === "core" ? coreCell(s) : cellHTML(s, v)).join("");
    prev = s.code;
  });
  const legend = BINS.map(([b, l]) => `<span><i class="trk-cell ${b}"></i>${l}</span>`).join("") +
    `<span><i class="trk-cell na"></i>not in file</span>`;
  return asEl("trk trk-card",
    `<div class="trk-scroll"><div class="trk-hm" style="grid-template-columns: max-content repeat(${vars.length}, 24px)">${h}</div></div>` +
    `<div class="trk-legend">${legend}</div>`);
}
```

```{ojs}
// one row per survey; pct_<var> is the non-missing share, empty when the variable is not in the file
{
  const cols = ["surveyid", "code", "country", "year", "survey", "stage", "vermast", "veralt",
    "n_ind", "n_hh", "welfare_type", "camp_share", ...D.schema_vars.map(v => "pct_" + v)];
  const rows = all.map(s => ({
    surveyid: s.surveyid, code: s.code, country: NAMES[s.code], year: s.year, survey: s.survey,
    stage: s.stage === "raw" ? "raw only" : "harmonized", vermast: s.vermast, veralt: s.veralt,
    n_ind: s.n_ind, n_hh: s.n_hh, welfare_type: WTYPE[s.welfare_type], camp_share: s.camp_share,
    ...Object.fromEntries(D.schema_vars.map(v => ["pct_" + v, s.missing ? cov(s, v) : null]))
  }));
  const csv = d3.csvFormat(rows, cols);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" }));
  a.download = `50by35_data_coverage_${D.generated}.csv`;
  a.className = "btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm";
  a.textContent = "Download coverage data (CSV)";
  return a;
}
```
